Inspection A records the fictional lighthouse height as 52 metres and the calibration offset as 73 units. Operator Mira signed the morning log.

Inspection B independently repeats the lighthouse height of 52 metres and the calibration offset of 73 units. Operator Jonas checked the scale.

Inspection C confirms the lighthouse height remains 52 metres and the calibration offset remains 73 units after a dry run.

Inspection D records the same 52 metre lighthouse and 73 unit calibration offset during the afternoon review.

Inspection E notes that the fictional lighthouse height is 52 metres and its calibration offset is 73 units, with no change requested.

Inspection F closes the series: lighthouse height 52 metres, calibration offset 73 units, and all six inspection notes retained.
